rebase: All 16 patches unchanged after clean rebase onto the pinned main.
scope: Review of unchanged PR code. Quantized main/PR regression checks and independent operator formulas; no original-unquantized-model or GGUF-conversion accuracy claim.

nativeChecks.scope: Snapshots, full session suite, independent MTP oracle, deep execution at 133120 tokens. Includes 25 sampling configurations, C2/4/6/8, images, cancellation and RAM/serialized state/RNG replay.
nativeChecks.timing: Correctness only; concurrent CPU builds invalidate speed claims.

mtpOracle.scope: Full-width normalization, split fusion, attention, recursive carry, full Q8 head, independent batches and cache replay with 1/8/9/32/33-row chunks.

fixedHistoryLogits.method: Task-only extension of the existing GPU probe, built identically on main and PR. Repeat/truncate public code/prose fixtures to exact depth; hold 128 continuation tokens fixed; compare all 248320 vocabulary logits at verifier widths 1 through 8, including partial rollback. Production source remained unchanged.
fixedHistoryLogits.nllScope: 127 next-token positions per case; corpus tokens, not a separate original-model teacher.

functional.correctness: All captures passed; matched outputs and prompt, prefill, cache and output token counts are exact.
notes: Per-request/per-phase gates, including raw and per-token aliases. Never average one request's regression against another request.
Original samples, alternating main/PR repeats, and unchanged-main controls retained. Two distinct request phases still fail.
Many queue/snapshot/wall samples remain inconclusive. Initial 58.25 s MTP queue stall did not recur. A roughly 2.3 s AR queue stall also occurred on unchanged main. Root causes were not established.

referenceMtpQualification.scope: Same pinned MTP reference executable in AR and MTP modes; pp2048/tg128, greedy, thinking off, seed1, C1 capacity4096; fresh and prepared-prefix requests.
referenceMtpQualification.disposition: User requested preservation of all existing llama.cpp data. No reference benchmark refresh was run. Historical September 22-23 numbers remain unchanged and are not requalified by this review. Mixed prose failed own-AR equivalence in the separate prerequisite control; repetition MTP was not attempted after that failure. Loading readiness does not qualify inference.

benchmarkRequests.scope: Every captured RequestObservation from the selected canonical sweep invocations, including calibration/preparation; same inputs and ordered server histories. Prefix-setup replies are checked separately for equality; their raw server logs remain retained. Identical concurrent peers pair by cache work, never by elapsed time.
benchmarkRequests.notes: A single paired capture can flag timing variance but cannot qualify it as a reproduced regression. Original samples and any focused follow-up stay retained. Functional timing findings above have independent main controls.
